desc: Sort the words and keep track of original indices to map back.
Compute the LCP array for adjacent words in the sorted list.
Precompute prefix and suffix arrays for sliding window minimums of size k-1 over the LCP array.
For each word in the original array, find its position in the sorted array, then use the precomputed prefix/suffix arrays to determine the max LCP of any k consecutive words in the remaining array.
Handle edge cases where the remaining array has fewer than k words.
